71x = 781 ⇒ x = 11.

Let total pencils be \(P\). Since 71 is the maximum number of students, \(\gcd(781,P)=71\). With \(781=71\cdot 11\), this means \(P=71k\) where \(k\) is not divisible by 11.

Thus \(P\) can be \(71,142,213,\dots\), so the number of pencils is not uniquely determined.

\boxed{\text{Cannot be determined}}
